428 tracked files, 302 Python. Counts in `[brackets]` are tracked files per directory.

## Start here

| If you are touching… | Start at |
|---|---|
| any path or filename | `backend/analysis/paths.py` — the single source of truth |
| any analysis output | `results_dir("<workflow>_<step>_<variant>")` from `analysis.paths` |
| a new survival estimator | `backend/analysis/models/survival/` |
| a new end-to-end analysis | `backend/analysis/workflows/<name>/` + a wrapper in `scripts/run/` |
| the production-risk forecast | `backend/analysis/workflows/production_risk/run.py` |
| the shipped Excel calculator | `vba/` and `scripts/deploy/` |
| agent conventions | `agents/AGENTS.md` |

## Layout

```text
.claude/  [1] — Claude Code project config — settings.json, skills/
.vscode/  [1] — editor config
agents/  [25] — agent instructions and per-analysis briefs
  analyses/  [23] — one brief per analysis line — handoffs, prompts, plans
analysis/ ⛔  [2] — LEGACY — migrating to backend/analysis/workflows/; do not add files here
  vt_failure/ ⛔  [1] — LEGACY — moved to backend/analysis/workflows/vt_failure/
backend/  [173] — FastAPI service, the analysis library, and the test suite
  analysis/  [121] — the reusable computation library — all new heavy logic lands here
    common/  [4] — plotting, Cox reporting, shared modelling config
    data/  [13] — loaders, label hygiene, failure-mode classification, run covariates
    features/  [9] — derived features and stress transforms
    models/  [17] — estimators — model code, no I/O
      survival/  [15] — the survival estimators: Weibull, Cox variants, CIF, landmark
    workflows/  [57] — end-to-end analyses; each package exposes a single entrypoint
      chemistry_cox/  [2] — chemistry Cox block
      esp_survival/  [14] — ESP survival stack — mixture fits, RUL, VBA bundle export
      production_risk/  [19] — production-risk forecast feeding the ПП plan
      vt_failure/  [21] — Vt failure analysis — the phased survival study
  app/  [18] — FastAPI service
    api/  [2] — HTTP routes
    core/  [2] — service config
    db/  [3] — SQLAlchemy models and session
    schemas/  [2] — pydantic request/response schemas
    services/  [7] — service logic — analysis, reporting, repair forecast, LLM client
  tests/  [32] — pytest suite — run with `cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`
docs/  [37] — committed documentation
  decisions/  [5] — decision records
  methodology/  [10] — method write-ups
  notes/  [11] — working notes and findings
  presentations/  [11] — report and deck sources
frontend/  [24] — Vue 3 client for the FastAPI service
  src/  [19] — app source
    assets/  [5] — logos and images
    components/  [10] — single-file Vue components — one per panel/module
    services/  [1] — API client
    styles/  [1] — global styles
scripts/  [132] — thin CLI wrappers — heavy logic belongs in backend/analysis/
  deploy/  [3] — launcher and exe builds
  features/  [3] — feature-table builds
  ingest/  [3] — raw to interim ingestion
  marts/  [3] — mart builds
  processing/  [7] — interim processing
  quality/  [2] — data-quality checks
  run/  [41] — workflow entrypoints — phase_<block>_<step>.py mirrors the analysis phases
streamlit_apps/  [12] — interactive explorers — Свод panels and model fitters
vba/  [14] — Excel VBA modules for the shipped calculator (ПикПолка / NPV_УВЧ)

Repo root: `CLAUDE.md`, `PROJECT_PROMPT.md`, `Pump2ProductionRisk.spec`, `README.md`, `docker-compose.yml`
```

## Key packages

**`backend/analysis/models/survival/`** — the survival estimators: Weibull, Cox variants, CIF, landmark

- `alarm_metrics.py` — Phase D — D4 alarm / operational metrics (the phase verdict).
- `bayesian_latent_weibull.py` — *(no module docstring)*
- `bootstrap_ci.py` — Well-cluster bootstrap CIs for K=2 mixture B10/B50/w₁ (Phase A T2).
- `cause_specific_cox.py` — Cause-specific stratified Cox helper for Phase B (B3/B4).
- `cif.py` — Aalen–Johansen cumulative incidence for competing risks (Phase B B2).
- `extended_cox.py` — Extended Cox model with time-varying coefficient via log-log scale regression.
- `landmark_cox.py` — Phase D — landmark survival models (D2 inference + D3 prediction).
- `latent_weibull_competing_risks.py` — *(no module docstring)*
- `screening_cox.py` — Reusable stratified-Cox screening cascade for the Phase C covariate blocks.
- `temporal_holdout.py` — Temporal-holdout evaluation for Phase C C5 — the stack's first out-of-sample test.
- `time_interaction_cox.py` — Time-interaction (extended) Cox via exact event-time episode splitting.
- `weibull_birth_death.py` — Unknown-K Bayesian Weibull mixture via birth-death MCMC.
- `weibull_em.py` — EM algorithm for K=2 Weibull mixture on raw (durations, events) data.
- `weibull_model.py` — *(no module docstring)*

**`backend/analysis/workflows/production_risk/`** — production-risk forecast feeding the ПП plan

- `backtest.py` — Out-of-time backtest of the ESP baseline failure model against actual outcomes.
- `config.py` — Configuration and defaults for the production-risk workflow.
- `crosswalk.py` — Data loading and crosswalks for the production-risk workflow.
- `esp_optime.py` — True operating-day clock for ESP runs, from daily telemetry.
- `esp_population.py` — ESP run population on the Свод clock, reconstructable at any analysis date.
- `export_excel.py` — Russian-language companion workbook for production-risk outputs.
- `failure_rate.py` — Monthly ESP failure-rate analysis, per УН (license area) and fleet-global.

- `mc_refit.py` — Refit the Mc/MR survival stratum from Свод + WellsArtificialLiftBig.

- `repair_compat.py` — Shape-compatible export for the legacy ``Прогноз ремонтов`` view.

- `t0_covariates.py` — t0-window covariates for the Ya->Mc Cox transfer.

- `vt_v32_hybrid.py` — Vt **v3.2 hybrid θ-model** — the deployable survival model on the v3.2 relabeled popula…

## Not in git

- `results/` — canonical output root — every new analysis writes here via `results_dir(slug)`
- `data/` — data layer: raw / interim / marts / warehouse, addressed through `analysis.paths`
- `analysis_outputs/` — LEGACY output, read-only — new output goes to results/
- `archive/` — retired code and outputs
- `temp/` — scratch — use results/ instead
- `catboost_info/` — CatBoost training scratch
- `build/` — PyInstaller build scratch
- `dist/` — built launcher artefacts
